name: Exterior Porch Floor RP Finish Coat 2
intent: RP finish coat 2 — faster rates than coat 1 (sealed aggregate base, less absorption). Encapsulates anti-slip aggregate.
doctrine: RP finish coat 2. Faster than coat 1: roll 275 vs 250, spray_backroll 475 vs 450, steps 5 vs 4 EA/hr. Sealed aggregate base absorbs less. Encapsulates anti-slip. Cut-in 90 LF/hr (known lines from coat 1).
